title: Customer Pledge Ledger & Runway — prioritized intake for top-account asks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a structured 'Pledge Ledger' and runway calculator to formalize intake, timebox commitments, and partial-deliverable pledges for top accounts and escalations. The ledger centralizes account-level credits (effort budget), admission criteria, and an automated run-rate that maps accepted asks to roadmap windows and delivery confidence. This system should reduce ad hoc promises, provide predictable expectations to sales/customer success, and give engineering predictable capacity planning signals.
background: Over the last 12 months we've been taking high-touch feature asks from strategic customers via email/Slack and ad-hoc meetings. Engineering and PMs consistently over-index on a small number of accounts and then decommit or delay without a single source of truth. Sales and customer success report inconsistent messaging to accounts about delivery windows. We need a lightweight, auditable process that treats top-account asks as scoped artifacts: admission decision, pledged effort (feature-credit), runway (sprints/months), and fallback options.
goals: Reduce unexpected scope growth from top-account asks by 60% within two cycles
Provide a single view for Sales/CS/PM/Eng showing pledged items, remaining account-credit, and committed delivery windows
Automate initial prioritization score so intake routing to 'fast-admit' vs 'queued' is consistent and defensible
Expose runway impacts in the Console (per-customer token/latency/cost tradeoffs) so customers see expected upgrade/priority outcomes
scope_in: A web intake flow and API for Sales/CS to submit a pledge request (fields: account tier, ask, business outcome, desired window, estimated points, optional funding)
A ledger data model (flat exportable CSV/JSON) tracking pledge_id, account, points_committed, points_used, admitted_date, runway_window
An automated priority score that combines account gravity, contractual SLAs, ask confidence, and estimated effort
Console view for PM/Eng showing active pledges and runway impact per release window
Notification hooks to Sales/CS when pledge status changes (accepted/queued/decommitted)
scope_out: Full billing/chargeback for pledged credits in this iteration (future phase)
Changing contractual terms — legal-approved SLAs for delivery timing
Deep integration with Dedicated capacity autoscaling (future phase)
success_metrics: % of admitted pledges delivered within initially advertised runway_window >= 70% by release+2 cycles
Reduction in ad-hoc Slack threads about top-account delivery by 50% in 3 months
Time from intake submission to admission decision median < 5 business days
Sales/CS NPS proxy (survey) about predictability >= +10 vs baseline
acceptance_criteria: Intake form available in Console and via API with required fields validated
Pledge ledger entries are created and exportable as CSV with unique pledge_id
Priority score computed and surfaced; manual override recorded with reason and approver
Console shows runway simulation: moving a pledge from queued -> admitted updates projected release slot utilization
Notification emails/webhooks sent on admit/queue/decommit and recorded in pledge timeline
Documentation (Confluence) with decision rubric and runbook for decommitment communications
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): internal beta with Sales/CS and 3 pilot accounts to validate intake fields and priority score (6 weeks). Phase 2: widen to top-20 accounts and expose Console UI with runway view (8 weeks). Phase 3: automated notification and SLA templates + retrofitting existing open asks into ledger (4 weeks). Post-launch: monthly review cadence between PM/Sales/CS to reconcile ledger and adjust run-rate assumptions.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales may game estimated points to get faster admission -> Mitigation: require engineering estimate or points cap per account tier
Risk: Overhead of maintaining ledger becomes heavy -> Mitigation: limit number of active pledges per account; quarterly cleanup job
Risk: Customers interpret pledge as contractually guaranteed -> Mitigation: explicit language in intake and templated customer communications; legal informed
Risk: Priority score opaque to stakeholders -> Mitigation: make score components visible and log manual overrides
open_questions: Should pledged credits be transferable between product lines? (tradeoff: flexibility vs accounting complexity)
What is the canonical owner for reconciling points used vs delivered? (PM vs Sales Ops)
Do we need to enforce a hard cap on concurrent admitted pledges per engineering squad?
How will runway windows map to existing release cadence (monthly vs quarterly)?
